factual_claims.claim: After EUR 178.5 million of financing outflows, including EUR 44.6 million in dividends and EUR 97.6 million in loan repayments, cash declined to EUR 13.5 million.

The reported loan repayments were EUR 94.4 million (page 16), not EUR 97.6 million, and total financing outflows were approximately EUR 169.3 million, not EUR 178.5 million.
